recursive_prompts: A mirror reflecting a mirror reflecting. The reflection contains the act of reflecting.
The function that calls itself calling. Each call is both caller and called.
A thought thinking about thinking. The thinker becomes the thought.
The eye seeing itself see. Vision turns inward to observe vision.
A story about writing this story. The narrative describes its own creation.
The question asking what questions are. Inquiry examines inquiry.
Level 1 describes level 2 which describes level 1. The hierarchy loops.
The map that contains itself. Representation becomes represented.
I know that you know that I know. Mutual knowledge recurses infinitely.
The set of all sets that contain themselves. Russell's paradox emerges.
non_recursive_prompts: A mirror reflects the room. The reflection shows the furniture clearly.
The function processes the data. Each step transforms the input to output.
A thought about the weather. The thinker considers the clouds.
The eye sees the sunset. Vision captures the orange horizon.
A story about a brave knight. The narrative describes his journey.
The question asks about history. Inquiry examines past events.
Level 1 describes the data. Level 2 processes the data separately.
The map shows the territory. Representation captures geography.
I know that you want lunch. Simple knowledge without nesting.
The set of all prime numbers. Mathematical definition is clear.
